description.narrative: The project’s goal is to improve food security, livelihoods and the nutritional status of vulnerable rural communities in the Kailahun district, targeting 40 communities (working directly with 1,200 members of farmer based organisations). The project is designed to enhance climate resilience and food and nutrition insecurity through the promotion and adoption of improved climate smart farming methods, promoting food processing and value addition options and locally designed irrigation systems for year-round crop cultivation, enhanced dietary diversity practices, promoting adoption of eco-friendly cook stoves, and sustainable management of natural resources including agroforestry and afforestation. The project employs gender-transformative approaches aimed at empowering women and creating equal opportunities for their participation in food systems initiatives.
